The seven-time grand slam champion has not played on the ATP Tour since April, when he withdrew from the Barcelona Open with a wrist issue, with Alcaraz missing his defence of his French Open title and Wimbledon. Alcaraz was due to return at the Cincinnati Open this month before withdrawing from that event, then enlisted the help of football transfer specialist Fabrizio Romano to announce his US Open comeback. messages.text: Kalpana shows guts to go with her class in Yorkshire Oaks

metadata.summary: King George heroine Kalpana just held on to land the Legends Global Yorkshire Oaks at York after a mighty scare from Sparan Nua.
metadata.content: Kalpana wins Yorkshire Oaks as gutsy display enough to see off Sparan Nua on day two of Ebor meeting | Racing News | Sky Sports Skip to content Kalpana wins Yorkshire Oaks as gutsy display enough to see off Sparan Nua on day two of Ebor meeting Kalpana backed up her King George success with another gutsy display to see off the fast-finishing Sparan Nua in a thrilling end to the Thursday feature on the Knavesmire. Thursday 20 August 2026 16:23, UK Image: Kalpana ridden by Colin Keane (left) passes Sparan Nua ridden by Rossa Ryan on the way to winning the Legends Global Yorkshire Oaks King George heroine Kalpana just held on to land the Legends Global Yorkshire Oaks at York after a mighty scare from Sparan Nua. Aidan O'Brien's outsider Sugar Island was immediately sent to the front and Ronan Whelan quickly distanced himself from the field, extending the advantage to 20 lengths turning for home. But as the main players began to eat into that lead, Colin Keane sent Kalpana to give chase over three furlongs out, hitting top gear two furlongs from home, only for Jim Bolger's Sparan Nua - who got a little squeezed at one stage - to make up plenty of ground and close the gap. The line just came in time for the 10-11 favourite to hold on by a short head, giving Keane, Andrew Balding and owners Juddmonte a second Group One in the space of 24 hours, after Item had landed the showpiece Juddmonte International on Wednesday. Lewis Hamilton has urged his Ferrari team to "apply the pressure" to title rival Kimi Antonelli as he seeks to chase down the Mercedes driver in the championship battle. The 2026 Formula 1 season resumes at the Dutch Grand Prix this weekend following the sport's summer break, with Antonelli leading Hamilton by 50 points at the top of the standings. There is a huge gap in experience between the pair, with the 41-year-old Hamilton chasing a record eighth drivers' title, while Antonelli, who turns 20 two days after Sunday's race in Zandvoort, is seeking a maiden championship in just his second F1 campaign.
